name: Magic Realm
description: The realm of Magic, a supernatural otherworld where travelers accumulate vis instead of experience and the effective Magic aura exceeds ten.

name: Twilight Void
description: A part of the Magic Realm fundamentally different from the rest, a timeless place connecting other places, reached through boundaries or vestiges and divided into provinces by Form.

name: Mundane realm
description: The ordinary world outside the Magic Realm, to which travelers may return through connected boundaries or vestiges.

name: Animal province
description: The Animal-aligned province of the Twilight Void: musky smells and brightly lit animals; sounds of creatures with Cunning transmit their thoughts.

name: Aquam province
description: The Aquam-aligned province of the Twilight Void: water and liquids shine out, and travelers can move through water or walk on it.

name: Auram province
description: The Auram-aligned province of the Twilight Void: misty and electric, clouds and smoke shine white and can be walked upon.

name: Corpus province
description: The Corpus-aligned province of the Twilight Void: glowing human figures and remains, with health and age visible.

name: Herbam province
description: The Herbam-aligned province of the Twilight Void: growing plants seen brightly with seasonal colors and lush aroma.

name: Ignem province
description: The Ignem-aligned province of the Twilight Void: a monochromatic place of light, shadow, heat and cold.

name: Imaginem province
description: The Imaginem-aligned province of the Twilight Void: images, colors, sounds and smells bombard the senses and species travel far.

name: Mentem province
description: The Mentem-aligned province of the Twilight Void: emotions, thoughts and minds are perceptible and intelligent beings appear as ghostly outlines.

name: Terram province
description: The Terram-aligned province of the Twilight Void: precious gems and metals shine like the sun; buried treasure is easily spotted.

name: Vim province
description: The Vim-aligned province of the Twilight Void: combines properties of the other spheres; magic things grow brighter with magnitude.

name: Province (Twilight Void)
description: One of at least ten versions of the Twilight Void, each associated with a Form tied to Magic Might; travelers perceive only things of their province.

name: Semita Errabunda
description: The covenant of Victor of Mercere and his magical horse Aeolus in the Aeolus example; it has a regio.

name: Nephelococcygia
description: A location known by all Birds of Nephelococcygia through their Homing Instinct, which cannot be forgotten.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The game setting; regio networks may lie in lakes, clouds or caves throughout it.

name: Boundary
description: Magic Realm feature with a level and Form through which travelers can pass into the Twilight Void; Creo can create them and Perdo reduce them.

name: Vestige
description: An insubstantial image or link in the Magic Realm associated with a Form, usable for travel through the Twilight Void.

name: Speed Level
description: Rating determining the length of a journey through the Twilight Void, from permanent to momentary.

name: Twilight
description: The state magi enter from magical overload; it is unclear whether the Twilight Void is where magi go in Twilight.

name: Final Twilight
description: The end state of a magus in Twilight; many Criamon doubt the Twilight Void is its destination.

name: Twilight Comprehension
description: Roll (Intelligence + Enigmatic Wisdom + stress die) used to navigate and comprehend experiences in the Twilight Void.

name: Essential Trait
description: A special Personality Trait describing a magic character's true form or nature that it cannot act against and magic cannot override.

name: Twilight Scars
description: Marks of becoming more magical; typically associated with the province traveled in the Twilight Void.

name: Acclimation
description: Process by which magic characters lose Magic Qualities unless they remain in auras, consume vis or maintain magical effects; not suffered in the Twilight Void.

name: Parma Magica
description: The Hermetic protective ritual; its duration expires on passing into or out of the Twilight Void and it cannot stack with Might for Magic Resistance.

name: Longevity Ritual
description: Laboratory enchantment unaffected by passage through the Twilight Void since it lacks a spell Duration.

name: Talisman
description: A magus's enchanted item bond, unaffected by passage through the Twilight Void.

name: Familiar
description: A magical companion bound to a magus; many are designed as grog- or companion-level magic characters.

name: Arcane Connection
description: Mystical link to a person or place; degrades one level on entering the Twilight Void and is needed to link vestiges and boundaries.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power; accumulated instead of experience in the Magic Realm and consumable by magic characters to replenish Might.

name: Warping
description: Magical corruption measured in Warping Points; gained from uncomprehended Twilight Void experiences.

name: Magic Might
description: Score giving a magic character its supernatural strength, Magic Resistance and powers, associated with a Form.

name: Might Points
description: Pool of points spent by magic characters to activate powers, recovered over 24 hours or faster in Magic auras.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Resistance to supernatural effects, granted innately by Magic Might or by Parma Magica.

name: Magic aura
description: Supernatural aura of the Magic realm; resting in it speeds Might recovery.

name: Minor Breakthrough
description: Hermetic research breakthrough (30 points) granting the Magic Realm Magic guidelines.

name: Insight
description: A way to convert vis gained in the Magic Realm into knowledge of a single Magic Realm effect.

name: Lab Text
description: Written laboratory notes; one from a magus who completed the Magic Realm breakthrough grants access to its guidelines.

name: Magic Realm Magic
description: Extensions to Hermetic magic enabling manipulation of vestiges, boundaries and travel in the Magic Realm, gained via a Minor Breakthrough.

name: Hermetic magic
description: The magic of the Order of Hermes, which works well in the Magic Realm but cannot natively affect boundaries and vestiges.

name: Ritual
description: Type of spell or power required for Boundary Target or Year Duration effects and effects of level 50+.

name: Magic character
description: A character with a Magic Might Score, created with Magic Character Creation rules or via a Virtue such as Transformed (Being).

name: True form
description: A magic character's essential qualities and shape: animal, human, spirit or thing.

name: Season (magic character)
description: Statistic replacing age for magic characters: spring, summer, autumn or winter, determining starting experience.

name: Character guide
description: A summary of requirements for designing a magic character type, used instead of a full sheet.

name: Magic Qualities
description: Supernatural advantages of characters with Might, bought with points equal to Might Score.

name: Magic Inferiorities
description: Supernatural disadvantages of magic characters that give additional Quality points.

name: Magic powers
description: Spell-like abilities of magic characters designed as Focus, Lesser, Greater, Ritual or Personal Powers.

name: Mastery points
description: Points spent to improve a power's Initiative, Might cost or related Abilities.

name: Confidence
description: Score and points allowing characters to boost rolls; magic characters may spend them for Ritual Powers or constant powers.

name: Inherent vis
description: The vis contained in a magic character's body, typically Might Score / 5 pawns.

name: The Gift
description: The magical talent enabling Hermetic magic, causing social penalties.

name: Gentle Gift
description: A form of The Gift that hides its disturbing traits.

name: Magical Air
description: A disturbing magical presence akin to The Gift, innate to magic spirits.

name: Mystery Cult
description: Group through which characters with The Gift can initiate new Virtues and Flaws.

name: Spell Mastery
description: Hermetic mastery of a spell, which powers may emulate via Improved Powers.

name: Magical theurgy
description: Secret lore by which each manifestation of a spirit is called an Aspect.

name: Aspect
description: A manifestation of a Daimon or spirit outside the Twilight Void.

name: Water-way
description: Special Atlantean Range targeting anything on the same water-way as the caster; equal to Sight.

name: Storm (Duration)
description: Special Atlantean Duration lasting until the end of a storm; equal to Concentration.

name: Body-of-water
description: Special Atlantean Target covering an entire lake, river or sea; equal to Structure.

name: Regio
description: A supernatural region; some are linked in networks travelled via (Land) Regio Network.

name: Supernatural Ability
description: Abilities such as Magical Meditation or (Form) Resistance linked to the supernatural.

name: Heroic Virtues and Flaws
description: Virtues and Flaws from Houses of Hermes: True Lineages that magic humans may take as Qualities and Inferiorities.

name: Hermetic Empowerment
description: Mystery path letting magi use a magic thing's Might Score.

name: Bind Magical Creatures
description: Mystery allowing magi to take advantage of magical creatures' Might.

name: Magic Realm travel
description: Rules for passing through boundaries and vestiges into the Twilight Void and traveling to a destination.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The order of magi; the Magic Realm breakthrough may have been achieved in its history but not disseminated.

name: House Criamon
description: Hermetic House whose magi call the Twilight Void Twilight or their Founder's realm outside time and doubt it is Final Twilight.

name: House Merinita
description: Hermetic House whose Faerie Magic can make faerie spells visible in the Vim province.

name: House Mercere
description: Hermetic House of Victor of Mercere.

name: House Bjornaer
description: Hermetic House whose chapter in Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults has rules for animals and mundane Qualities.

name: Redcaps
description: Messengers of the Order; Aeolus's Folk Ken specialty.

name: Founders
description: The Founders of the Order of Hermes, who never developed spells affecting boundaries and vestiges.

name: Atlanteans
description: Exiled practitioners of a magic studied by magi with the Atlantean Magic Virtue.

name: Bonisagus
description: Founder of Hermetic magic who never developed spells to affect Magic Realm boundaries and vestiges.

name: Plato
description: Philosopher whose Realm of Forms classicists identify with the Twilight Void.

name: Victor of Mercere
description: Magus of House Mercere at Semita Errabunda who rides the magical horse Aeolus.

name: Aeolus
description: A talking magical horse (Magic Might 8, Animal), Magical Animal Companion of Victor of Mercere; vain, proud and lecherous.

name: Victor's magical amulet
description: Amulet woven into Aeolus's mane that lets the horse ride across water, mud or any surface once per day on a command word.

name: Daimon
description: Powerful magical creatures who live in the Twilight Void and cannot leave without forming an Aspect.

name: Magic Hound
description: Sample magic animal character guide (Might 0-10 Animal) with the Inexorable Hunter power.

name: Elemental
description: Magic things of raw elemental matter, rarely intelligent; can be created by Enliven the Gross.

name: Ghost
description: Insubstantial magic spirits aware of their incorporeal nature.

name: Genius loci
description: A spirit of place whose Healing power heals all wounds of creatures indigenous to its locus.

name: Birds of Nephelococcygia
description: Magic birds who all know the location of Nephelococcygia via Homing Instinct.

name: Ghostly Warder
description: Example of a grog-level magic character.

name: Charger
description: A war horse from the Book of Mundane Beasts used as Aeolus's base.

name: Giant
description: Full-blooded giants use magic human rules with the Gigantic Quality.

name: King of the wolves
description: Magical being whose blessing might grant a Skinchanger pelt.

name: Magus
description: A Hermetic wizard; magus-level magic characters are comparable to one.

name: Companion
description: Companion-level magic characters have special status at a covenant.

name: Grog
description: Grog-level magic characters cannot take Major Qualities or Inferiorities.

name: Hedge wizard
description: Characters aligned with Magic but lacking Might.

name: Creo
description: Hermetic Technique; associated with Magic Realm guidelines, provinces, or powers in this text.

name: Intellego
description: Hermetic Technique; associated with Magic Realm guidelines, provinces, or powers in this text.

name: Muto
description: Hermetic Technique; associated with Magic Realm guidelines, provinces, or powers in this text.

name: Perdo
description: Hermetic Technique; associated with Magic Realm guidelines, provinces, or powers in this text.

name: Rego
description: Hermetic Technique; associated with Magic Realm guidelines, provinces, or powers in this text.

name: Animal
description: Hermetic Form; associated with Magic Realm guidelines, provinces, or powers in this text.

name: Aquam
description: Hermetic Form; associated with Magic Realm guidelines, provinces, or powers in this text.

name: Auram
description: Hermetic Form; associated with Magic Realm guidelines, provinces, or powers in this text.

name: Corpus
description: Hermetic Form; associated with Magic Realm guidelines, provinces, or powers in this text.

name: Herbam
description: Hermetic Form; associated with Magic Realm guidelines, provinces, or powers in this text.

description: Hermetic Form; associated with Magic Realm guidelines, provinces, or powers in this text.

name: Imaginem

name: Terram
description: Hermetic Form; associated with Magic Realm guidelines, provinces, or powers in this text.

name: Vim
description: Hermetic Form; associated with Magic Realm guidelines, provinces, or powers in this text.

name: Locus of the Literatus
description: CrIm 20 Ritual that draws the caster's location as a vestige in a book, producing a map for travel in the Magic Realm.

name: Adoration of the Magical Isle
description: CrAq 50 Ritual permanently increasing an Aquam boundary in the Magic Realm by one, to a maximum of 5.

name: See the Paths through the Void
description: InAu 20 spell revealing Auram boundaries and vestiges and allowing passage into the Twilight Void.

name: Comprehending the Mystic Doorway
description: InHe 30 spell to see into the Twilight Void through a wooden structure's vestige, giving +9 to travel.

name: Torch of the Realm-bound Reveler
description: MuIg 25 spell letting the target affect fiery objects with Magic Realm Magic as if it had Ignem Might.

name: Visions of Olympus
description: MuMe 35 spell making beings in the Mentem province perceptible outside the Twilight Void.

name: When Fortuna Blinks
description: PeCo 10 spell making the magus vanish from the Magic Realm momentarily to avoid a deadly threat.

name: Repose of the Eternal Moment
description: PeCo 35 Ritual causing the target to vanish into the Twilight Void for its duration.

name: The Night-Badgers' Burrow
description: ReAn(Te) 20 spell moving targets from the Animal province to the Terram province.

name: Swift Wings of Timeless Days
description: ReVi 20 spell reducing the caster's Twilight Void journey by three steps.

name: Enchantment of the Scrying Pool
description: InAq 30 ritual requiring 6 pawns of vis, used as an example for Imbued with the Spirit of (Form).

name: The Inexorable Hunter
description: Magic Hound power (InCo 25) letting it flawlessly follow a scent.

name: From Nag to Charger
description: Aeolus's power (MuAn 15) to change himself into any kind of horse.

name: Crafter of (Form)
description: Common Focus Power duplicating non-Ritual Creo or Rego spells of one Form.

name: Enliven the Gross (Elemental Form)
description: Ritual Power creating and controlling an elemental from raw elemental matter.

name: Equine Shape
description: Personal Power letting the character transform into a horse until sunrise or sunset.

name: Flight of the Hummingbird
description: Constant Personal Power letting the character fly by concentrating.

name: Grant (Major Flaw)
description: Ritual Power imposing a named Major Flaw on a victim.

name: Grant (Minor Flaw)
description: Ritual Power imposing a named Minor Flaw on a victim.

name: Grant Puissance in (Ability)
description: Lesser Power bestowing prowess in an activity to groups or individuals.

name: Grant (Major Virtue)
description: Ritual Power bestowing a named Major Virtue.

name: Grant (Minor Virtue)
description: Ritual Power bestowing a named Minor Virtue.

name: Guide
description: Greater Power (ReMe 30) subtly influencing a group toward a course of action.

name: Hands of the Magical Animal
description: Personal Power letting an animal carry and manipulate items as with human hands.

name: Healing
description: Ritual Power that heals the worst wound of a human or animal when it performs a specific action.

name: Human Shape
description: Personal Power transforming a creature into a normal human shape.

name: Master of (Form)
description: Focus Power duplicating non-Ritual Muto or Perdo spells of one Form.

name: Oath-Swearing
description: Ritual Power enforcing a solemnly sworn oath with a Minor Flaw for violators.

name: Sight Beyond Sight
description: Personal Power extending all five senses as far as the creature can see.

name: Call the Flock
description: Example song of power a bird may be taught via Composer of Power.

name: Magic Animal
description: Special Virtue for magic characters whose true form is a beast; includes innate No Hands and Mute.

name: Magic Human
description: Special Virtue for magic characters of human form, typically Corpus, with inherent Monstrous Appearance.

name: Magic Spirit
description: Special Virtue for insubstantial magic characters like ghosts or Daimons.

name: Magic Thing
description: Special Virtue for animated matter; Might depends on Size and has Temporary Might and No Fatigue.

name: Magical Master
description: Major Social Status Virtue for magic characters.

name: Magical Champion
description: Minor Social Status Virtue for magic characters.

name: Magical Covenfolk
description: Free Social Status Virtue for magic characters.

name: Transformed (Being)
description: Major Virtue giving a character a Magic Might Score through play; e.g. Transformed Human.

name: Composer of Power
description: Major Supernatural Virtue letting a character teach songs of power replicating its Powers.

name: Focus Power
description: Power with a narrow range of spontaneous effects; a Major Quality or Major Supernatural Virtue.

name: Greater Power
description: Formulaic power with 50 spell levels; a Major Quality or Major Supernatural Virtue.

name: Lesser Power
description: Formulaic power with 25 spell levels; Minor Quality or Minor Supernatural Virtue.

name: Ritual Power
description: Major Quality granting ritual-level powers that reduce Might Score when used.

name: Personal Power
description: Minor Quality/Virtue for limited powers (Personal range or constant).

name: Greater Immunity (Deprivation)
description: Major Supernatural Virtue making a character immune to deprivation like magic beings.

name: Essential Virtue
description: Virtue granting a beneficial Essential Trait at +3 (Minor) or +6 (Major).

name: Magical Warder
description: Major General Virtue listed among new Virtues.

name: Homing Instinct
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue letting a character always know how to reach a number of locations.

name: (Land) Regio Network
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue granting access to a network of regiones with travel of one Diameter.

name: Magical Blood
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue listed among new Virtues.

name: Master of (Form) Creatures
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue listed among new Virtues.

name: Variable Power
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue listed among new Virtues.

name: Voice of the (Land)
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue listed among new Virtues.

name: Atlantean Magic
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue granting Water-way range, Storm duration and Body-of-water target.

name: Extractor of (Form) Vis
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue letting a magus extract Form vis from an exemplifying Magic aura.

name: Imbued with the Spirit of (Form)
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue letting a magus substitute Long-Term Fatigue for vis of a Form.

name: Ferocity
description: Minor General Virtue granting Confidence Points only in triggering situations.

name: Inoffensive to (Beings)
description: Minor General Virtue making a Gifted character's presence not disturb one type of being.

name: Magical Mount
description: Minor General Virtue listed among new Virtues.

name: Unaffected by The Gift
description: Minor General Virtue often taken by magic animals.

name: Giant Blood
description: Major General Virtue representing mixed giant and human lineage.

name: Skinchanger
description: Virtue allowing transformation into an animal, e.g. via a wolf pelt.

name: Affinity with (Ability)
description: Virtue affecting character creation that cannot be transformed in the Magic Realm.

name: Skilled Parens
description: Virtue affecting character creation that cannot be transformed in the Magic Realm.

name: Improved Characteristics
description: Virtue raising Characteristics, used by Aeolus.

name: Great (Characteristic)
description: Virtue raising a Characteristic, e.g. Great Quickness for Aeolus.

name: Long-Winded
description: Virtue required for horses such as Aeolus and the Magic Hound.

name: Keen Sense of Smell
description: Virtue required by the Magic Hound character guide.

name: Sharp Ears
description: Virtue of the Magic Hound.

name: Tough
description: Virtue of the Magic Hound.

name: Venus's Blessing
description: Minor Virtue taken by Aeolus.

name: Common Sense
description: Virtue whose storyguide advice is compared to the Guide power.

name: Subtle Magic
description: Virtue offsetting the Limited Gestures penalty.

name: Quiet Magic
description: Virtue offsetting the Limited Speech penalty.

name: Large
description: Size-increasing Virtue used in Miniature example.

name: Spirit Familiar
description: Mystery Virtue for binding a spirit familiar.

name: Fatigue Mastery
description: Major Quality letting a character spend Fatigue levels as Might Points.

name: Gentle Air
description: Major Quality removing social penalties of Gifted or Magical Air.

name: Gifted
description: Major Quality giving a magic character The Gift or something like it.

name: Gigantic
description: Major Quality magically increasing Size and Strength while reducing Quickness.

name: Improved (Characteristic)
description: Major Quality raising a Characteristic already +5 or more.

name: Natural Appearance
description: Major Quality letting a magic character look like a normal human or living creature.

name: No Fatigue
description: Major Quality making the character tireless without Fatigue levels; free for Magic Things.

name: Vis Mastery
description: Major Quality letting the character expend its magic as vis.

name: (Form) Resistance
description: Minor Quality aligning Magic Resistance to a Form.

name: Gift of Speech
description: Minor Quality letting a character speak as a human.

name: Improved Abilities
description: Minor Quality granting 50 experience points.

name: Improved Attack
description: Minor Quality increasing a natural weapon's Attack by 2.

name: Improved Confidence
description: Minor Quality increasing Confidence Score by one.

name: Improved Damage
description: Minor Quality increasing a natural weapon's Damage by 3.

name: Improved Defense
description: Minor Quality increasing a natural weapon's Defense by 2.

name: Improved Fatigue
description: Minor Quality adding a Fatigue level.

name: Improved Initiative
description: Minor Quality increasing a natural weapon's Initiative by 3.

name: Improved Might
description: Minor Quality increasing Magic Might by 1.

name: Improved Powers
description: Minor Quality granting 5 mastery points for powers.

name: Improved Recovery
description: Minor Quality halving Might recovery time.

name: Improved Soak
description: Minor Quality increasing Soak by 2.

name: Magical Meditation (Quality)
description: Major Quality giving the Supernatural Ability Magical Meditation at 1.

name: Magical Friend
description: Minor Social Status Flaw for magic characters; taken by Aeolus.

name: Magical Monster
description: Major Social Status Flaw for magic characters.

name: Magical Animal Companion
description: Flaw indicating a companion magical animal, like Aeolus for Victor.

name: No Hands
description: Flaw innate to all magic animals.

name: Mute
description: Flaw innate to magic animals and common for magic things.

name: Crippled
description: Flaw common for magic things.

name: Proud
description: Minor Personality Flaw taken by Aeolus.

name: Lecherous
description: Minor Personality Flaw taken by Aeolus.

name: Low Self-Esteem
description: Flaw affecting Confidence and Ferocity eligibility.

name: Poor (Characteristic)
description: Flaw lowering a Characteristic, prerequisite for Reduced (Characteristic).

name: Age Quickly
description: Flaw making even magical beings age.

name: Arthritis
description: Flaw incompatible with Limited Gestures.

name: Lame
description: Flaw incompatible with Limited Movement.

name: Afflicted Tongue
description: Flaw incompatible with Limited Speech.

name: Small Frame
description: Size-reducing Flaw used in the Gigantic example.

name: Offensive to (Beings)
description: Flaw combined with the Gentle Gift to be disturbing to only some beings.

name: Acclimation Prone
description: Major Inferiority doubling difficulty of avoiding Acclimation.

name: Major Flaw (Inferiority)
description: Major Inferiority granting a Major General or Supernatural (Magic) Flaw.

name: Miniature
description: Major Inferiority magically shrinking the character.

name: Monstrous Appearance
description: Major Inferiority imposing -6 to social situations; inherent to Magic Humans.

name: Reduced (Characteristic)
description: Major Inferiority reducing a Characteristic already -5 or less.

name: Temporary Might
description: Major Inferiority: Might recovers only slowly in auras and wounds shed vis; inherent to Magic Things.

name: Limited Gestures
description: Minor Inferiority limiting manipulation to vague gestures.

name: Limited Movement
description: Minor Inferiority restricting travel to short distances.

name: Limited Speech
description: Minor Inferiority preventing intelligible speech.

name: Minor Flaw (Inferiority)
description: Minor Inferiority granting a Minor General or Supernatural (Magic) Flaw.

name: Reduced Abilities
description: Minor Inferiority subtracting 50 experience points.

name: Reduced Attack
description: Minor Inferiority reducing a natural weapon's Attack by 2.

name: Reduced Defense
description: Minor Inferiority reducing a natural weapon's Defense by 2.

name: Reduced Fatigue
description: Minor Inferiority removing a Fatigue level.

name: Reduced Initiative
description: Minor Inferiority reducing a natural weapon's Initiative by 3.

name: Reduced Might
description: Minor Inferiority reducing Magic Might by 1.

name: Reduced Power
description: Minor Inferiority subtracting 5 mastery points from powers.

name: Reduced Soak
description: Minor Inferiority reducing Soak by 2.

name: Susceptible to Deprivation
description: Minor Inferiority making the character need air, food and water.

name: Enigmatic Wisdom
description: Ability used in Twilight Comprehension in the Twilight Void.

name: Concentration
description: Ability used to speed travel through the Twilight Void and for Homing Instinct.

name: Magical Meditation
description: Supernatural Ability granted by the Magical Meditation Quality.

name: Athletics
description: Ability, innate to horses and hounds.

name: Awareness
description: Ability, innate to horses and hounds.

name: Brawl
description: Ability, innate to horses and hounds.

name: Hunt
description: Ability of the Magic Hound.

name: Survival
description: Ability innate to horses.

name: Area Lore
description: Ability used to locate networked regiones.

name: Charm
description: Ability of Aeolus.

name: Folk Ken
description: Ability of Aeolus.

name: Living Language
description: Ability of Aeolus.

name: Profession: Mount
description: Ability of Aeolus.

name: Stealth
description: Ability of Aeolus.

name: Animal Handling
description: Ability of Aeolus.

name: Artes Liberales
description: Ability of Aeolus.

name: Latin
description: Ability of Aeolus.

name: Organization Lore: Order of Hermes
description: Ability of Aeolus.

name: Philosophiae
description: Ability of Aeolus.

name: Finesse
description: Ability improvable with mastery points.

name: Penetration
description: Ability and total determining a power's ability to overcome Magic Resistance.

name: Leadership
description: Ability limiting how many students a Composer of Power can teach.

name: Wilderness Sense
description: Ability that can reveal how long a storm will last.
